title: MOJO - A Swingin' Christmas
seo_title: MOJO - A Swingin' Christmas in Springfield, MO
description: The Missouri Jazz Orchestra (MOJO) performs a night of swinging Christmas music, with guest vocalists, audience sing-alongs, and possibly a visit from a red-suited cat. It takes place Saturday, November 28, 2026 at 7:30 PM at 325 Park Central E in Springfield, Missouri, presented by the Gillioz Theatre.
